outcome.detail: The cohort's evidence lane - paper_input_ledger, paper_decision_ledger, paper_trade_ledger, paper_incident_ledger, the trade database and the pre-T0 preflight/admission artifacts - lived only on the prior host, by design (.gitignore), and did not migrate: the move was made with a git bundle, which carries history and no untracked runtime state. The Owner has confirmed the prior host will not be used again, so the lane is unrecoverable. Nothing is claimed from the window: no capability is proven, no trade lifecycle is observed, and no result is reconstructed.

notes: Entry state C: no paper-admissible survivor exists, so PAPER_ALPHA_COHORT = NONE. Its T0 was frozen on 2026-09-08 after a passing pre-T0 gate on the prior host, and the cohort was closed on 2026-09-13 as EVIDENCE_LANE_LOST_IN_HOST_MIGRATION: the project moved to a native Ubuntu host by git bundle, which carries no untracked runtime state, and the Owner has confirmed the prior host will not be used again. The frozen t0_utc, cohort_id and source_commit stay exactly as they were recorded - they are history, never reusable - and the closed row claims nothing: PAPER_TRADING_OPERATIONAL_CAPABILITY = NOT_PROVEN, FULL_TRADE_LIFECYCLE = NOT_OBSERVED. A future forward-paper run is a new cohort with a new T0, admitted only by a fresh pre-T0 pass on the new host and a new Owner authorisation.
